summary: MiMo V2.6 Flash is free on OpenCode Zen for a limited time. Announced by @opencode on 2026-09-21 as "free for the next week" (through ~2026-09-28). OpenCode's docs list model id mimo-v2.6-flash-free on the Zen chat-completions endpoint and note that during the free period collected data may be used to improve the model. The post also states Flash and Pro are available in Go.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Zen at opencode.ai/zen and copy your API key.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, select OpenCode Zen, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select MiMo V2.6 Flash Free (model id: mimo-v2.6-flash-free).
